about: What PostgreSQL sends for a table pre-check's figures at each level, and for its duplicate keys (docs/mvp/PRECHECKS.md §4): a plain side, and one with a composite key, two key maps, a filter and a typeMap column. Regenerate only with a contract change.

counts: SELECT (count(*))::text, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (t."userid"::text COLLATE "C") IS NULL))::text FROM "public"."users" AS t
columns: SELECT (count(*))::text, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (t."userid"::text COLLATE "C") IS NULL))::text, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE t."email" IS NULL))::text, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (t."email"::text COLLATE "C") = ''))::text, (min(char_length((t."email"::text COLLATE "C"))))::text, (max(char_length((t."email"::text COLLATE "C"))))::text, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE t."full_name" IS NULL))::text, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (t."full_name"::text COLLATE "C") = ''))::text, (min(char_length((t."full_name"::text COLLATE "C"))))::text, (max(char_length((t."full_name"::text COLLATE "C"))))::text, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE t."legacy_flag" IS NULL))::text, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE t."legacy_flag"))::text FROM "public"."users" AS t
distinct: SELECT (count(DISTINCT (t."email"::text COLLATE "C")))::text, (count(DISTINCT (t."full_name"::text COLLATE "C")))::text, (count(DISTINCT t."legacy_flag"))::text FROM "public"."users" AS t
duplicates: SELECT count(*), coalesce(sum(d.n), 0) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM "public"."users" AS t WHERE (t."userid"::text COLLATE "C") IS NOT NULL GROUP BY (t."userid"::text COLLATE "C") HAVING count(*) > 1) AS d

counts: SELECT (count(*))::text, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE CASE WHEN (t."branch"::text COLLATE "C") ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN %(m0_prefix)s || lpad((t."branch"::text COLLATE "C"), greatest(%(m0_width)s, length((t."branch"::text COLLATE "C"))), '0') END IS NULL OR CASE WHEN (t."acct"::text COLLATE "C") ~ %(m1_pattern)s THEN regexp_replace((t."acct"::text COLLATE "C"), %(m1_pattern)s, %(m1_replacement)s) END IS NULL))::text FROM "crm"."Accounts" AS t WHERE (t."status" IN ( %(w0)s , %(w1)s ) AND t."Amount" > %(w2)s AND NOT t."closed")
columns: SELECT (count(*))::text, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE CASE WHEN (t."branch"::text COLLATE "C") ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN %(m0_prefix)s || lpad((t."branch"::text COLLATE "C"), greatest(%(m0_width)s, length((t."branch"::text COLLATE "C"))), '0') END IS NULL OR CASE WHEN (t."acct"::text COLLATE "C") ~ %(m1_pattern)s THEN regexp_replace((t."acct"::text COLLATE "C"), %(m1_pattern)s, %(m1_replacement)s) END IS NULL))::text, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE t."Amount" IS NULL))::text, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE t."opened" IS NULL))::text, (to_jsonb(min(t."opened")) #>> '{}')::text, (to_jsonb(max(t."opened")) #>> '{}')::text, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE t."status" IS NULL))::text, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (t."status"::text COLLATE "C") = ''))::text, (min(char_length((t."status"::text COLLATE "C"))))::text, (max(char_length((t."status"::text COLLATE "C"))))::text, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE t."raw" IS NULL))::text, (min(octet_length(t."raw")))::text, (max(octet_length(t."raw")))::text, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE t."seen" IS NULL))::text, (to_jsonb(min(t."seen")) #>> '{}')::text, (to_jsonb(max(t."seen")) #>> '{}')::text, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE t."rate" IS NULL))::text, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE t."doc" IS NULL))::text, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE t."fee" IS NULL))::text, (sum(t."fee"::numeric))::text, (min(t."fee"))::text, (max(t."fee"))::text FROM "crm"."Accounts" AS t WHERE (t."status" IN ( %(w0)s , %(w1)s ) AND t."Amount" > %(w2)s AND NOT t."closed")
distinct: SELECT (count(DISTINCT t."opened"))::text, (count(DISTINCT (t."status"::text COLLATE "C")))::text, (count(DISTINCT t."raw"))::text, (count(DISTINCT t."seen"))::text FROM "crm"."Accounts" AS t WHERE (t."status" IN ( %(w0)s , %(w1)s ) AND t."Amount" > %(w2)s AND NOT t."closed")
